bio.text: Anthony G. Brown assumed office as Maryland's 47th Attorney General on January 3, 2023.
Previously he represented Maryland's 4th Congressional District from 2017 to 2023, was Lieutenant Governor from 2007 to 2015, and served in the Maryland House of Delegates from 1999 to 2007.
He is a retired Colonel in the Army Reserve who served as an aviator and Judge Advocate General.
Ballotpedia lists a Harvard University bachelor's degree (1984) and law degree (1992).
